bugs.title: Anchor navigation lands section headings under the fixed top bar (missing scroll-margin-top)
bugs.viewport: 390x844 (top bar present at ≤1024px, so affects all mobile/tablet widths)
bugs.description: Drawer nav links scroll the target section flush to the top of the viewport (section top = 0). The fixed .mnav-bar is 69px tall, so the section kicker (e.g. "BRAND") is fully hidden and the h2 heading (e.g. "Color System") sits at y=61 — its top 8px clipped under the bar. Computed scroll-margin-top is 0px on both section and h2. Reproduced on color-system (scrollY=4687) and typography (scrollY=6973). Post-navigation overlap sweep found 4 occluded elements in the bar band: DIV.inner, DIV.sec-head, DIV.sec-kicker, H2.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: At 390x844: 1) tap hamburger in fixed top bar; 2) tap "Color System" in the drawer; 3) drawer closes and page smooth-scrolls; 4) observe the section heading at the top of the viewport.
bugs.expected: After anchor navigation the target section heading (and kicker) renders fully visible at or below the topbar height (~69px), i.e. scroll-margin-top ≥ bar height.
bugs.actual: Section top = 0px, h2 top = 61px < bar height 69px; kicker fully hidden, heading glyphs clipped. scroll-margin-top = 0px. Overlap sweep: 4 elements intersect the 69px bar band at scrollY=4687.
bugs.suggested_fix: Add to CSS: `section[id]{scroll-margin-top:84px}` (69px bar + ~15px clearance), or equivalently `html{scroll-padding-top:84px}`.

bugs.title: 42 interactive controls below the 44x44 minimum touch-target size at 390px
bugs.viewport: 390x844 (component sizes are viewport-independent; violation count measured at 390)
bugs.description: 42 visible <button> elements are shorter than 44px in height (widths pass everywhere except the 32-36px stepper −/+ buttons which fail both axes). Groups: .btn standard buttons h=41px (Get quotes, Save draft, Connect DMC, Export, Cancel, Continue, Back, Save deal sheet, Default, Disabled, Connect · −1 credit); .tab chips h=38px (Compare, Deal sheet, Proposal, History, Day 1-7 x2 sets); .btn-sm buttons h=32px (Small, Respond x2, Decline x2, Top up, Day 1-5 chips, Export PDF, Send to customer, stepper −/+ x6). All are in-page demo controls; top-bar hamburger, theme toggle and all 20 drawer links pass at exactly 44px. No <a>, <input>, <select> or <textarea> violations.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: At 390x844: scroll to Atoms & UI Kit / Forms / Data Display sections; measure button rects (e.g. document.querySelector('.btn').getBoundingClientRect().height === 41).
bugs.expected: All visible interactive elements measure at least 44x44 px (page's own accessibility section claims "min 44×44 targets").
bugs.actual: 42 buttons measure 32-41px tall (and 6 stepper buttons 32-36px wide), e.g. ".btn" 41px, ".tab" 38px, ".btn-sm" 32px, stepper "−"/"+" 32x32.
bugs.suggested_fix: Raise min-height to 44px on .btn and .tab (and min-width on stepper buttons), or expand hit area with padding/::after overlay while keeping visual size; document any intentional dense-pattern exceptions in the accessibility section.
